# Vendored browser code

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scalar.js` | `@scalar/api-reference`, `dist/browser/standalone.js` from the npm registry | 1.77.0 | MIT, `LICENSE-scalar` |

The console configures Scalar with its default web fonts, its request proxy and its telemetry
off, and hides the "try it" client, so the page loads nothing from the internet. To upgrade,
fetch the package tarball from the registry, copy the same file here and update this table.
